summary: Claude Code is a terminal-based AI coding assistant that helps developers build features, debug issues, navigate codebases, and automate tasks directly from the command line.

sections.title: Installation
sections.content: Prerequisites: Node.js 18 or newer, and a Claude.ai or Claude Console account. Install with npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code, navigate to your project, and run claude.

codeExamples.code:
# Install Claude Code
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code

# Navigate to your project
cd your-awesome-project

# Start coding with Claude
claude
# You'll be prompted to log in on first use
codeExamples.description: Basic installation and startup commands for Claude Code

sections.title: What Claude Code does for you
sections.content: Claude Code provides four main capabilities: build features from plain English descriptions with planning and implementation, debug and fix issues by analyzing codebases, navigate any codebase with project-wide awareness and external data sources via MCP, and automate tedious tasks like fixing lint issues and resolving merge conflicts.

sections.title: Why developers love Claude Code
sections.content: Works directly in your terminal with existing tools, takes direct action by editing files and running commands with MCP extensibility, follows Unix philosophy for composability and scriptability, and provides enterprise-ready security, privacy, and compliance built-in.

codeExamples.code: tail -f app.log | claude -p "Slack me if you see any anomalies appear in this log stream"
codeExamples.description: Example of composable Unix-style usage with log monitoring
